document.abstract: A Kerr-cell shutter has been used in this laboratory for the photography of high-temperature, transient deuterium plasmas confined by magnetic fields. The inherent advantages of high resolution, short exposure durations, and reliability are valuable for this type of work. Photographs of plasmas produced by both linear and theta-pinch devices are shown.
